title: [review] 03-adaptation.md: Table inconsistent with prose for MQTT-S
description: Lines 127-128 show both UDP ports as '10883 | equal | not-sent', but line 113 states Rule 7 uses 'direction bit + residue for the non-10883 port'. The table is incomplete - it should reflect that one port may be non-10883 and require value-sent handling.
